# Provenance: entry_history_self

**Source**: live `GET /api/entry/8450051/history/` from the real FPL API on
2026-10-19 (curl, no auth), for #102.

**Edits**: a self-cohort id; `current`, `past` and `chips` trimmed to their first 2 / 1 / 1 entries. Values are otherwise as received. The history response
